title: Sidney Bechet and learning to read music
summary: Picou says Bechet learned on a tin flute, and that students should learn to read music first.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear

blocks.x: Now do you think it's possible to learn the clarinet just by yourself even without learning to read music? Like some people just pick it up. Sidney Bechet never did learn to read music so well I don't believe did he?

I don't think he reads much music but he plays wonderful I think. Sidney Bechet learned how to play the clarinet with a tin flute. What an tin flute. That's the way he learned. From that he pick up the clarinet. He used to come back to my house and I'll finish him up all the clarinet. Is it possible to learn to play pretty well without learning to read music very well do you think? Or do you advise people to learn music, to read the music first? Learn how to read music first. That's the first thing to do. Then you do it the right thing. Yes. When you started you had a regular method book. Oh yeah. Regular method book. You don't remember what book it was I guess. Yeah. Let me see what's the name of that book. Tell me.
